description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 225.0 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Poison 3 with Stacking] and [Vengeful Prince Mode] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Attach Poison 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3

description.name: Vengeful Prince Mode
description.text: Casts Eblan Style Greased Lightning after another ally uses a Poison ability, grants [Instant ATB 3] and [Poison Ability +30% Boost 3] to the user after casting Eblan Style Greased Lightning six times, removed after casting Eblan Style Greased Lightning six times
